name: Interviews
description: Transcribes the active interview sequence on this Mac (whisper), finds each answer with the local AI model (Ollama, no internet) and adds one marker per answer to a safe copy: the marker name is the topic, the comment a short outline, and it spans the answer. Takes about 15 minutes for an hour of interview. Then Cut & raise answers cuts the clips at each answer marker and moves the answers up one track, on the copy only.

inputs.label: Interviewee (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Tahnee, used in the outlines

inputs.label: Audio track (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A1; empty = all unmuted tracks

actions.label: Find answers and add markers
actions.confirm: Transcribe this sequence and find the answers on this Mac? It takes about 15 minutes for an hour of interview. A safe copy of the sequence is made and the markers go on the copy; the original is not changed.

actions.label: Cut & raise answers
actions.confirm: Cut the clips at the start and end of every answer marker on this TOOLKIT COPY and move each answer up one track? Cuts keep video and audio linked. Only a TOOLKIT COPY is changed; nothing is deleted or saved.
